remarks: Picture Perfect home on a quiet street lovingly maintained over the years. Newly renovated chef's kitchen with top appliances, beautifully restored hardwood floors through-out, living room w/ fireplace, wonderful family room w/ cathedral ceilings leading to a beautiful terrace overlooking a manicured fenced in level yard with specimen trees & plantings. Bonus office 4th bedroom on 1st floor. Close to Cos Cob shopping & train station.Additional FAR available- Plenty of Room to Expand! Turn Key Home, Ready to move right in!
